Spreadsheets · In development

Spreadsheet editor

Excel and Google Sheets, rebuilt for the browser.

Open now

Spreadsheets has these main features: 300+ functions, several sheets, freeze panes; Saves XLSX and CSV, opens CSV. It opens Excel (.xlsx), OpenDocument spreadsheet (.ods), CSV, TSV.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.

What you can do with Spreadsheets

  • A free spreadsheet in your browser
  • Budget spreadsheet template
  • A free Excel alternative in your browser
